notice: Derived extraction; authentication, transport envelopes and payload staging omitted. Original hash is in the disposition manifest. Device output is an observation, not proof of emitted light.

observations.command:
date -u
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
cat /proc/uptime
pidof avocd
for tv_pid in $(pidof avocd); do
 echo PROCESS=$tv_pid
 awk 'index($0,"libave.so") || index($0,"libvideoenhance") || index($0,"[heap]") { print }' /proc/$tv_pid/maps
 if test -r /proc/$tv_pid/mem; then echo PROC_MEM_READABLE; else echo PROC_MEM_NOT_READABLE; fi
 readlink /proc/$tv_pid/exe
done
